description: This file implements a USB Device Firmware Upgrade (DFU) class driver for Zephyr OS, handling USB descriptors, class requests, state management, and firmware upload/download operations.

methods.name: dfu_check_app_state
methods.description: Checks if the DFU device is in an application state (IDLE or DETACH).

methods.name: dfu_reset_counters
methods.description: Resets internal counters related to firmware transfer.

methods.name: dfu_flash_write
methods.description: Writes data to flash memory during firmware update.

methods.name: dfu_enter_idle
methods.description: Transitions the DFU state machine to IDLE and sets USB descriptors accordingly.

methods.name: reboot_schedule
methods.description: Schedules a system reboot after a delay.

methods.name: dfu_class_handle_to_host
methods.description: Handles DFU class requests from the host (e.g., GETSTATUS, UPLOAD).

methods.name: dfu_class_handle_to_device
methods.description: Handles DFU class requests directed to the device (e.g., DNLOAD, DETACH).

methods.name: dfu_class_handle_req
methods.description: Dispatches DFU class requests to appropriate handler based on direction.

methods.name: dfu_status_cb
methods.description: USB status callback to handle connection events.

methods.name: dfu_custom_handle_req
methods.description: Handles custom USB requests such as SET_INTERFACE.

methods.name: dfu_interface_config
methods.description: Configures the interface descriptor with the given interface number.

methods.name: dfu_work_handler
methods.description: Processes firmware data chunks during DFU download.

methods.name: usb_dfu_init
methods.description: Initializes the DFU subsystem, including flash and work queue setup.

methods.name: is_dfu_started
methods.description: Checks if DFU transfer is in progress.

methods.name: wait_for_usb_dfu
methods.description: Waits for ongoing DFU process to complete or timeout.
